svg.text: Generated by tools/figures/sim_readme.py from sim/ inputs and committed results. Synthetic simulation output: a design aid with no evidence credit (evidence gate below).

g.text: Terms: CF1, CF2 … = causal factor in a hazard record (CF1, CF2 …) · FLT-nnn = walker fault in sim/faults.yaml · GCS = ground control station · GPS = Global
Positioning System · HAZ-nnn = hazard record (safety/hazards/HAZ-xxx-nnn.yaml) · PX4 = PX4 Autopilot, the open-source flight-control software candidate for
SUS-A1 · SF-nnn = walker failure-search family (sim/search) · SITL = software-in-the-loop simulation · SU-nnn = UAV PX4 SITL scenario · SUS-A1 = dockable
observation UAV · UAV = uncrewed aerial vehicle (drone)
